name: HA Overview
author: duarte-gui
description: Your Home Assistant dashboards in the Omarchy bar: click the icon and the dashboard drops down, drawn natively card by card — switches, sliders, thermostats, alarm keypads, live cameras, history graphs and maps — with Assist and Home Assistant's notifications alongside.

barWidget.description: A Home Assistant dashboard one click away. Pick which dashboards the dropdown lists, switch views with tabs, and control lights, switches, covers, climate, media, locks, alarms and cameras without opening a browser. Pin entities beside the bar icon, get notified when they change, talk to Assist, and see history, maps, energy and the logbook. State changes arrive live over Home Assistant's websocket.

schema.label: Home Assistant address
schema.description: Where Home Assistant is: an IP such as 192.168.0.10, a hostname, or a full URL. A bare IP or hostname gets Home Assistant's port 8123. The gear button in the panel edits it.

schema.label: Access token
schema.description: A long-lived access token, created in Home Assistant under your profile, Security. It is only ever sent to Home Assistant, over stdin to the bridge process, never in a command line. The gear button in the panel takes it.

schema.label: Dashboards in the dropdown
schema.description: Comma-separated dashboard url_paths, for example lovelace, dashboard-energy. Empty lists every dashboard Home Assistant has. The gear button in the panel writes this for you.

schema.label: Columns
schema.description: How many columns the cards are laid out in. A panel view always uses one.

schema.label: Panel width (px)
schema.description: Width of the dropdown. It never grows past the screen.

schema.label: Panel height cap (px)
schema.description: The tallest the dropdown gets before it scrolls.

schema.label: Camera refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often camera pictures are refreshed. Only runs while the panel is open.

schema.label: Notify failed actions
schema.description: When a keybinding or IPC call fails while the panel is closed, say so with a desktop notification.

schema.label: Shown in the bar
schema.description: Entity ids whose icon appears beside the bar icon while they are on, open or armed, comma-separated. Empty shows the alarm panels. The pin button on an entity's page in the panel writes this for you.

schema.label: Notify on changes
schema.description: Entity ids that send a desktop notification whenever their state changes, comma-separated. The bell button on an entity's page in the panel writes this for you.

schema.label: Notify when an alarm goes off
schema.description: An urgent desktop notification when any alarm panel is triggered.

schema.label: Home Assistant's notifications
schema.description: Show each new Home Assistant notification (the bell in its sidebar) as a desktop notification.

schema.label: Map tiles
schema.description: Draw map cards on OpenStreetMap tiles, which Home Assistant itself fetches and caches (its map_tiles proxy, 2026.9 and later), so the map talks only to Home Assistant. Off, a map card is a list of who is where.

schema.label: Map colours
schema.description: auto draws the map dark in a dark Omarchy theme and light in a light one; dark and light always do.

schema.label: Assist pipeline
schema.description: The id of the Assist pipeline the Assist page talks to, which sets its language. Empty uses Home Assistant's preferred pipeline. The settings page in the panel lists them.
